pairs.subject: deterministic-prefix-caching
pairs.evidence: crates/engine-http/src/lib.rs:1133 The cache stores HTTP responses directly, and searches of the context and repository found none of the listed prefix-caching terms, so the subject's transform-prefix and live-random-tail precondition does not hold.

techniques.evidence: crates/core/src/cache.rs:286 Entries are SQLite rows, rather than individual serialized head-output files published by competing loader workers.
crates/engine-http/src/lib.rs:540 Cache eligibility examines HTTP request properties; there is no transform chain whose cache boundary must be discovered.
crates/core/src/vcr.rs:94 VCR intentionally replays recorded results, including sampled answers; it is not a caching dataset consumed by a training loader.
crates/core/src/cache.rs:68 The key identifies an HTTP request, not a record plus an assembled transform head requiring advisory pipeline hashing.
crates/core/src/lru.rs:24 This is capacity-driven LRU eviction for pooled handles, not an epoch-based dataset window with background replacement.
crates/core/src/cache.rs:98 The cache retrieves typed HTTP responses by key and age; it accepts no callable transform chain requiring purity classification.
